plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan critique approved the architecture with changes. Concern 1 fixed by adding explicit wallBreached/breachEntered route latches. Concern 2 fixed by serializing and comparing map config, spawn, rooms, tile flags, and terrain across windowed/headless paths. Concern 3 fixed by deriving AI locations from buildFloor5MapConfig manifest plumbing. Concern 4 fixed for RNG streams by deriving runtime keys from manifest labels; the unused checkpointCount manifest/config option was removed after follow-up review because Slice 1 only supports one authored checkpoint pocket. Concern 5 reviewed and deferred: DEFEAT uses existing ScenarioRunOutcome taxonomy only for abnormal command-post destruction in this skeleton; later loss taxonomy should widen with live damage gameplay.

code_review.notes: Round 1 found no code/runtime/security issues and noted only the then-incomplete review ledger. Round 2 found checkpointCount was threaded through manifest/config/schema but unused by the authored Slice 1 generator; resolved by removing that unsupported option until a later slice implements multi-checkpoint geometry.

independent_grade.notes: The change cleanly implements the Floor 5 siege foundation. It establishes the map generator with deterministic behavior, properly sets up the scenario initialization, adds a dedicated lab, and includes thorough testing for the headless pipeline and map generation. Layer boundaries are respected, and new systems are correctly wired.
